Based on the visual evidence in the image, the answer to "abdomen present?" is most likely **yes**.

The image shows a visceral surface (likely the peritoneum, which lines the abdominal cavity) with numerous small, pale-yellow nodules. This appearance is highly characteristic of **peritoneal carcinomatosis** (disseminated cancer cells throughout the abdominal lining) or miliary tuberculosis of the peritoneum. Because these findings are located on the serosal lining of the abdominal cavity, the abdomen is what is depicted in the image.
